adapters.notes: Modelling choice: each observation is exploded into its own record keyed by entity name (region entity.observations). Without it, add_observations rewrites the whole entity line and the destructive test would count an append as an overwrite, a false destructive VIOLATION. Consequence: the order of observations within an entity is not treated as state; in a knowledge graph it carries no meaning.
